conversation.Statement: Hello, thank you for calling Amazon Account Security. My name is Kevin. I'm here to help resolve the issue with your account today. May I have your full name to verify your identity?
Hi Kevin, yes, it's Linda Harper.
Thank you, Linda. For your protection, can you confirm the email address associated with your Amazon account?
Sure, it's lindaharper99@gmail.com.

Perfect, thank you. Linda, I see here that there was a security alert: your Amazon account was flagged for suspicious activity, possibly due to a harmful login attempt. I want to assure you I'm here to help keep your account safe.
Oh no. I rely on my Amazon a lot. I can't afford to lose it. Has anything been compromised?

At this point, your account access is temporarily frozen to prevent unauthorized transactions. We'll need to do a quick verification and then a system scan to make sure everything is secure. May I confirm your phone number on file?
Thank you, Linda. For your convenience, I can guide you step-by-step to restore your access. Do you have a laptop or smartphone available right now?
I have my laptop here.
Great, please open your browser. We'll use our Amazon Secure Connect tool to verify your account. In your address bar, type in 'amzsecurityresolve.com' and let me know once the page loads.
Okay, it's loaded. It asks for a session code.
That's correct. Please enter the code 842109, and click 'Connect'. This will allow us to scan for any unauthorized activities together.
Done. Now it's showing something about remote access.
Yes, that's normal. This gives us a secure view to help you resolve the issue. Your privacy is important to us, and you are always in control. Do you see a prompt to accept the connection?
Yes, I clicked accept.

Thank you, Linda. The scan shows there may be unauthorized attempts to use your payment methods. To protect you, we need to temporarily transfer the available funds from your account to a secure Amazon holding wallet, then back once your account is cleaned. This is just a safety protocol.
Wait, you need me to move my money? How does that work?
Please don't worry. We'll guide you step-by-step. Can you log in to your online banking in another tab? We never store your details, this is only to help protect your funds from unauthorized access.
Okay, I'm logged in.
Thank you. For the secure transfer, select the 'Wire Transfer' option. I'll provide the Amazon holding account details for this process.
Alright, it's asking for a recipient name and account number.

Please enter 'Amazon Client Security' as the recipient. The account number is 0123456789, and the routing number is 123456789. Double-check to ensure accuracy. This process is entirely reversible once your account is secure.
Okay, I've entered that. How much should I transfer?

Please transfer the available balance in your checking account. This will prevent any further unauthorized deductions. Once the threat is cleared, we will guide you to return the funds to your account.
I only have about $2,000 left. Is that enough?
That is sufficient, Linda. Our priority is your safety. Please confirm when the transfer is complete so we can proceed with securing your Amazon account and refunding your money.
Alright, the transfer is processing. Will I get an email confirmation?
Yes, you'll receive an email from our secure support address within the next 30 minutes. Please let me know if you see any suspicious activity or messages in the meantime.
Thank you, Kevin. I hope this fixes the issue. I've been really stressed about scams lately.

You're in good hands, Linda. Your diligence today has helped prevent any further problems. Once the transfer is verified, I will walk you through restoring full access and ensuring everything is safe.
Alright, just let me know if you need anything else.
Absolutely. Please stay on the line while I confirm the transaction status. Your account security is our top priority.
